sections.heading: STATE lane - RESOLVED, and the real lesson

fields.label: Verified
fields.value: The batch lane IS inside a running race: 1674 simulation calls in 1.5s (0x004233e0=1224, 0x00470670=360, 0x0047eb30=90). Probes validated first on a stock race: 11266/2867/59690 in-race vs 0/0/0 at title, track-confirm and start-attempt. phase=0 IS the racing state.

fields.label: Three wrong calls before it
value: 'hung game' - from a white screenshot (the grab misses the D3D9 backbuffer even in a confirmed race)
'never reaches a race' - from probes that were the RESULTS/round-end subset, all frontend in hooks.csv
'the scenario does not populate these arrays' - assumed

fields.label: Common fault
fields.value: A strong conclusion from an instrument never validated. A counter never seen to fire anywhere proves nothing when it reads zero.

fields.label: Real finding
fields.value: With the race PROVEN running, 0x00639dc4 and 0x0068432c are still all-zero and 0x00421930/0x004b4050 are called 0 times in 1.5s. Those candidates are simply not exercised in Quick Battle. Nothing was wrong with the lane, harness, ports or scenario.

fields.label: Cheap fix earned
fields.value: PRE-SCREEN before authoring: MASHED_COUNT_RVAS=0x..,0x.. py -3.12 re/frida/statenav.py --round 60 counts any number of RVAs in ONE boot (18 in the validation run).

fields.value: AudioThreadDescInit (0x005aef00) declared void; original returns param_1 in EAX and callers TEST it — audio/stream worker thread never spawned, GUI thread hangs on INFINITE wait. Fixed in port; pending re-classify with return-value evidence.
